PR #1544 — [Chat Event Ownership] Reject duplicate callbacks and stale session effects

hachej epic/chat-event-ownership → main 34 files · +2872 −45 view on GitHub ↗
OPEN CI: 16 passed · 0 failed · 0 pending · 5 skipped Audit: callback repair + thermo/abstraction review passed; exact-base/candidate desktop/mobile browser proof passed; review findings fixed

1 · What this touches

RemotePiSession.onFrame
-  infer acceptance from cursor advance
-  notify host callback
+  ask reducer/store for semantic acceptance
+  notify only when accepted and stream still owns generation

The PR fixes ownership at the event reduction seam: canonical sequence consumption is no longer mistaken for semantic acceptance. PiChatPanel keeps the existing host callback contract, while RemotePiSession now reports only reducer-accepted events. Earlier commits also fence Resume state by transport identity and preserve first-prompt startup policy. It does not widen public exports, move package ownership, contact a real model in proof, or change shared design components. Review piChatReducer.ts, piChatStore.ts, and remotePiSession.ts first, then the real caller and revision-bound browser evidence.

256+ <div class="card" style="margin-top:12px"><p>The PR fixes ownership at the event reduction seam: canonical sequence consumption is no longer mistaken for semantic acceptance. <code>PiChatPanel</code> keeps the existing host callback contract, while <code>RemotePiSession</code> now reports only reducer-accepted events. Earlier commits also fence Resume state by transport identity and preserve first-prompt startup policy. It does not widen public exports, move package ownership, contact a real model in proof, or change shared design components. Review <code>piChatReducer.ts</code>, <code>piChatStore.ts</code>, and <code>remotePiSession.ts</code> first, then the real caller and revision-bound browser evidence.</p></div>

1484+ var list = document.getElementById('files');

1486+ function sortBy(mode) {

24+ } }), {

26+ })

48+ setPhase('current turn streaming')
49+ await sleep(700)
50+ emit({ type: 'agent-end', seq: 2, turnId: 'turn-stale', status: 'ok' })
51+ await sleep(300)
52+ setPhase('stale terminal rejected')
53+ await sleep(700)
54+ emit({
55+ type: 'error', seq: 3, turnId: 'turn-current', retryable: false,
56+ error: { code: ErrorCode.enum.INTERNAL_ERROR, message: 'Deterministic proof failure', retryable: false },
57+ })
58+ await sleep(300)
59+ setPhase('current turn failed')
60+ await sleep(700)
61+ emit({ type: 'agent-end', seq: 4, turnId: 'turn-current', status: 'ok' })
62+ await sleep(300)
63+ setPhase('contradictory terminal rejected')
64+ await sleep(700)
65+ emit({ type: 'agent-start', seq: 5, turnId: 'turn-next' })
66+ await sleep(300)
67+ setPhase('valid next turn streaming')
68+ await sleep(700)
69+ emit({ type: 'agent-end', seq: 6, turnId: 'turn-next', status: 'ok' })
70+ await sleep(300)
71+ setPhase('valid next turn completed')
72+ })()
73+ return Response.json({ accepted: true, cursor: 0, clientNonce: 'proof-nonce' })
74+ }
75+ setPhase(`unexpected request: ${init?.method ?? 'GET'} ${url}`)
76+ throw new Error(`Unexpected proof request: ${init?.method ?? 'GET'} ${url}`)
77+ }, [emit])
78+
79+ return <main>
80+ <header>
81+ <div><p className="eyebrow">PR #1544 · deterministic browser proof</p><h1>Chat event ownership</h1></div>
82+ <div className="counter" aria-live="polite"><span>Host completion callbacks</span><strong data-testid="completion-count">{completionCount}</strong></div>
83+ </header>
84+ <section className="journey">
85+ <p><strong>Journey:</strong> send one prompt through the real <code>PiChatPanel → RemotePiSession → reducer → callback</code> path.</p>

87+ <div className="phase" data-testid="phase"><span>Stream checkpoint</span><strong>{phase}</strong></div>
88+ </section>

90+ <PiChatPanel
91+ sessionId="ownership-proof"
92+ hydrateMessages
93+ serverResourcesEnabled={false}
94+ storageScope="pr-1544-proof"

96+ onTurnComplete={() => setCompletionCount((value) => value + 1)}
97+ className="h-full"
98+ />
99+ </section>
100+ </main>
101+}

1+---
2+github: https://github.com/hachej/boring-ui/pull/1544

8+
9+# [Chat Event Ownership] Deliver PR #1544
10+
11+## Problem
12+
13+PR #1544 is green at `c3a721509c57c63cf02a81f47d6a01573c7536af`, but its latest independent review found that `RemotePiSession` treats cursor advance as event acceptance. The reducer may advance its cursor while rejecting a stale-turn or contradictory terminal event, so `onEvent` can reach `onTurnComplete` for an event the state machine did not accept. Exact-SHA sandbox and before/after Playwright evidence are also missing, and the branch must be validated against current `origin/main`.
14+
15+Canonical lineage is batch Bead `wt-391-forward-clu5.3` under `pr-review-batch`; this lane does not modify that epic.
16+
17+## Solution
18+
19+Keep the existing public callback intent unless inspection proves it must change. Make reducer acceptance explicit enough that the transport invokes callbacks only for accepted events, cover rejected terminal-event cases at the reducer/session/real caller seams, reconcile current main, capture revision-bound browser evidence, then obtain independent standards/thermo/abstraction review of the final SHA. Update existing PR #1544 only; never merge from this lane.
20+
21+## Decisions
22+
23+- Preserve callback/public-contract semantics by default; this is an implementation repair, not authority to redesign the callback.
24+- If correctness genuinely requires a public contract or package-ownership change, stop at the protected boundary and identify the precise owner decision rather than silently widening scope.
25+- Proof precedes final independent review so the reviewer can inspect actual revision-bound evidence.
26+- Delivery routing is determined from the complete final diff and current `origin/main`, not the current 218-addition/22-deletion snapshot.
27+
28+## Flag / Abstraction
29+
30+- Needed?: No feature flag; this repairs event acceptance and callback ownership on an existing path.
31+- Path: `RemotePiSession` stream → reducer acceptance → callback → `PiChatPanel` turn completion.
32+- Rollback: revert the PR's Chat Event Ownership commits; no migration or persisted-data transform is involved.
33+- Protected trigger to re-check: public API/callback contract and package-boundary ownership. Current package production churn is 46 lines (37 in `PiChatPanel.tsx`, 5 in `remotePiSession.ts`, 6 in `piChatPanelHooks.ts`, additions+deletions), below the >500 trigger; tests are excluded from that numeric trigger only.
34+
35+## Test Seams
36+
37+- Highest public seam: `RemotePiSession` event callback observed through `PiChatPanel`'s `onTurnComplete` behavior.
38+- Existing prior art: `remotePiSession.test.ts` stream/recovery cases and `PiChatPanel.test.tsx` real remote transport case.
39+- Avoid testing: cursor movement alone as a proxy for reducer acceptance; mocks that bypass the real reducer/callback path.
40+
41+## Acceptance
42+
43+- Stale-turn and contradictory terminal events do not trigger callback-owned completion behavior.
44+- Accepted events are still dispatched before callback observation, duplicates/gaps remain fenced, and valid terminal events complete once.
45+- Branch is conflict-free and verified against current main.
46+- Exact final SHA has package checks, deterministic before/after Playwright video, present-pr artifact, independent standards/spec + thermo verdicts, and an explicit abstraction PASS.
47+- Existing PR #1544 receives complete revision-bound proof and either `factory: MERGE-READY <sha>` when eligible/enforced or one protected merge-approval card. The lane never merges.
48+
49+## Proof
50+
51+- `pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-agent exec vitest run src/front/chat/__tests__/PiChatPanel.test.tsx src/front/chat/pi/__tests__/remotePiSession.test.ts <focused reducer tests>`
52+- `pnpm --filter @hachej/boring-agent typecheck`
53+- `pnpm lint:invariants` and applicable import/package checks
54+- Exact-SHA sandbox execution plus same-fixture Playwright before/base and after/candidate recording with deterministic assertions
55+- GitHub CI and controlled integration validation against the then-current `origin/main`
56+- Independent `fresh_review`: standards/spec, thermo, and explicit package-abstraction PASS
57+
58+## Slices
59+
60+### Slice: Repair accepted-event callback semantics
61+**Bead:** `wt-391-forward-3brt.1`
62+**Delivers:** reducer/session/caller repair, focused regressions, and current-main reconciliation.
63+**Blocked by:** None.
64+**Proof:** focused Vitest, agent typecheck, invariants, clean current-main relationship.
65+**Review budget:** Inside one implementation/review round; stop for a genuine public-contract decision.
66+
67+### Slice: Capture exact-revision browser proof
68+**Bead:** `wt-391-forward-3brt.2`
69+**Delivers:** exact-SHA sandbox checks, deterministic before/after Playwright video, and present-pr artifact.
70+**Blocked by:** `wt-391-forward-3brt.1`.
71+**Proof:** artifact/report paths, commands, assertions, base/head SHAs.
72+**Review budget:** Inside one proof session.
73+
74+### Slice: Obtain independent final review
75+**Bead:** `wt-391-forward-3brt.3`
76+**Delivers:** exact-SHA standards/spec and thermo verdicts plus explicit abstraction PASS; fixes and re-review if needed.
77+**Blocked by:** `wt-391-forward-3brt.2`.
78+**Proof:** reviewer session/model/provenance, SHA, findings and dispositions.
79+**Review budget:** Maximum four rounds for the SHA lineage.
80+
81+### Slice: Validate integration and route delivery
82+**Bead:** `wt-391-forward-3brt.4`
83+**Delivers:** current-main candidate validation, final risk classification, complete PR proof/show-me/handover, and authorized terminal route.
84+**Blocked by:** `wt-391-forward-3brt.3`.
85+**Proof:** base/main/head SHAs, CI, package churn calculation, review/proof links, final PR comment or owner-card-ready record.
86+**Review budget:** Inside one integration session; any code change invalidates affected evidence and loops back.
87+
88+## Out of Scope
89+
90+- Merging PR #1544, force-pushing, creating a replacement PR, changing unrelated chat behavior, modifying `pr-review-batch`, or weakening tests/proof requirements.
91+
92+## Open Questions
93+
94+- **Worker/reviewer:** Can reducer acceptance be exposed internally while preserving the current public callback contract? If no, record the exact protected owner decision.
95+- **Final classifier:** Does the actual final diff match any protected boundary after all repairs and current-main reconciliation?
96+
97+## Plan review
98+
99+The latest independent repair review (`6dc9126c-3edb-4c3c-8b61-5278271881a9`, `openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol`) supplied the central adversarial finding and proof gaps used by this plan. No separate pre-gate independent-review mechanism is exposed to the Orchestrator; the owner decides at Gate 1 with that limitation explicit.

1+# Chat Event Ownership — revision-bound browser proof
2+
3+## Revisions and scenario
4+
5+- **Actual PR base / before:** `3db6a237d0ace94c83fb4967e43407d65202706e`. This is the original PR base reported by GitHub and contains the callback-before-reducer bug. The source-backed fixture uses normal hydration (rather than the later `hydrateMessages=false` path), so the exact base can establish its event stream before the prompt without importing unrelated first-prompt behavior.
6+- **Repaired production code:** `1f91c319958f0a2d37b2badb13174b4068234055`.
7+- **Report-bound exact proof execution:** `fd08b2b3d3918c9a6a8ab1d49b831bbba60ae939`. Commits after the code SHA contain only Bead/proof artifacts, the bounded cold-start timeout, presentation generation, and metadata sanitization. The Bead handoff binds the later artifact-only presentation refresh to its own exact-SHA rerun.
8+- **Fixture:** one redacted prompt, session `ownership-proof`, fixed model `anthropic/proof-model`, no credentials, customer data, network backend, or host paths in artifacts.
9+- **Viewports:** desktop `1440×900`; mobile `390×844`. Playwright scales recorded video to its codec-safe maximum (`800×500` and `368×800` respectively); assertions run at the declared viewport.
10+
11+The same real browser journey renders `PiChatPanel` from each target revision. The user enters **“Verify terminal event ownership”** and clicks **Submit**. The deterministic NDJSON stream then delivers:
12+
13+```text
14+agent-start(turn-current)
15+agent-end(turn-stale) # reducer rejects
16+error(turn-current) # accepted terminal error
17+agent-end(turn-current, ok) # contradictory; reducer rejects
18+agent-start(turn-next)
19+agent-end(turn-next, ok) # one valid completion
20+```
21+
22+The fixture renders the host-facing `onTurnComplete` count above the real chat panel. This is necessary because the stock standalone playground does not wire that optional host callback, so its false delivery has no observable browser surface. No production source was changed for testability.
23+
24+## Assertions and result
25+
26+| Checkpoint | Before `3db6a237` | Candidate `1f91c319` | Required candidate result |
27+| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
28+| stale terminal consumed | 1 completion | 0 completions | no false completion |
29+| contradictory terminal consumed | 2 completions | 0 completions | no false completion |
30+| valid next turn completed | 3 completions | 1 completion | exactly once |
31+| desktop | PASS (expected regression reproduced) | PASS | PASS |
32+| mobile | PASS (expected regression reproduced) | PASS | PASS |
33+
34+The base is intentionally asserted to reproduce two false callbacks rather than recorded as an unexplained failed test. Candidate assertions demand zero callbacks at both rejected checkpoints and exactly one after the valid next turn.
35+
36+## Commands
37+
38+Executed at report-bound proof head in exact-SHA sandbox lease `2f8877ef-485a-4f07-9234-cae31e17d4cd` after `git rev-parse HEAD` and `.factory-sha` both returned `fd08b2b3d3918c9a6a8ab1d49b831bbba60ae939`:
39+
40+```bash
41+mkdir -p /tmp/pr1544-proof-base
42+git archive 3db6a237d0ace94c83fb4967e43407d65202706e | tar -x -C /tmp/pr1544-proof-base
43+ln -s "$PWD/node_modules" /tmp/pr1544-proof-base/node_modules
44+ln -s "$PWD/packages/agent/node_modules" /tmp/pr1544-proof-base/packages/agent/node_modules
45+
46+PROOF_TARGET_ROOT=/tmp/pr1544-proof-base \
47+PROOF_REVISION_LABEL=before \
48+PROOF_EXPECTED_REJECTED_COUNT=2 \
49+PROOF_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/pr1544-proof-before \
50+pnpm exec playwright test --config docs/issues/1544/browser-proof/playwright.config.ts
51+# PASS: desktop + mobile
52+
53+PROOF_TARGET_ROOT="$PWD" \
54+PROOF_REVISION_LABEL=candidate \
55+PROOF_EXPECTED_REJECTED_COUNT=0 \
56+PROOF_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/pr1544-proof-candidate \
57+pnpm exec playwright test --config docs/issues/1544/browser-proof/playwright.config.ts
58+# PASS: desktop + mobile
59+```
60+
61+The extracted base gets dependency-only `node_modules` symlinks from the sandbox; all aliased Agent source remains the archived exact base. The common proof fixture is served from the proof head.
62+

64+
65+| Revision | Desktop | Mobile | Playwright JSON |
66+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
67+| before | [video](results/before/desktop/journey.webm) · [final frame](results/before/desktop/final.png) | [video](results/before/mobile/journey.webm) · [final frame](results/before/mobile/final.png) | [results](results/before/playwright-results.json) |
68+| candidate | [video](results/candidate/desktop/journey.webm) · [final frame](results/candidate/desktop/final.png) | [video](results/candidate/mobile/journey.webm) · [final frame](results/candidate/mobile/final.png) | [results](results/candidate/playwright-results.json) |

72+## Relevant package proof

1+# PR 1544 revision-bound browser proof
2+
3+This source-backed fixture renders the real `PiChatPanel` from `PROOF_TARGET_ROOT`, records desktop and mobile journeys, and exposes the host's `onTurnComplete` count. The user submits a prompt; a deterministic NDJSON stream then delivers a stale terminal, the current turn's error, a contradictory terminal, and one valid next turn.
4+
5+```bash
6+PROOF_TARGET_ROOT=/path/to/revision \
7+PROOF_REVISION_LABEL=before \
8+PROOF_EXPECTED_REJECTED_COUNT=2 \
9+PROOF_OUTPUT_DIR=/tmp/pr1544-before \
10+pnpm exec playwright test --config docs/issues/1544/browser-proof/playwright.config.ts
11+```
12+
13+Use `PROOF_EXPECTED_REJECTED_COUNT=0` for the repaired candidate. Both projects use identical fixture data and steps; viewports are desktop `1440×900` and mobile `390×844`. Base is expected to report two false callbacks before the valid completion (final count 3); candidate must remain at zero through both rejected terminals and finish at exactly one.
